cpuEndpoints.scope: All samples retained. Bucket metrics are descriptive endpoint associations only, never residency, core-clock, cause or adjusted/filtered performance. Linux has no class buckets.

measurement.definition: Sum of timed draws plus timed final picture retirement per finite group; delayed recording is inside draw2. Clear/readback/hash/PNG/bookkeeping are outside draw windows. Instrumentation counters/Clock calls are included.
measurement.amortizationScope: Standalone same-path-owner per-group cache lifecycle model, not measured product plan reuse; hot mode cold recording remains separately charged by the analyst.

finalPictureRetirement.scope: Final cleanup separately measured; delayed finite groups already retire inside their accounted lifecycle. Hot-mode final disposal is excluded from hot draw quantiles and must be charged along with hotCacheSetupRecord in any finite-use analysis.
